## 5. Scotland vs Morocco Predicted Lineups
[...]
When making a Morocco vs Scotland prediction, you must consider the predicted lineups. The Scotland vs Morocco team news will be announced one hour before kick-off but there are some key players to look out for in both teams. Scotland will need the experience of Andy Robertson in defence, the midfield duo of Scott McTominay and John McGinn in midfield, and the attacking threat of Ché Adams.
[...]
Morocco need Achraf Hakimi and Nayef Aguerd in defence, with the former also a key attacking outlet, Ismael Saibari and Neil El Aynaoui in midfield, and Brahim Díaz in attack. It will be interesting to see if Ayoub El Kaabi keeps his place as central striker or if Youssef En-Nesyri can force himself back into the starting XI for Morocco.

## Scotland v MoroccoScotland v Morocco
[...]
FIFA World Cup 2026™First Stage · Group C · New York/New Jersey Stadium06/13/2026BrazilMorocco22:00
[...]
Scotland01
[...]
After taking on Haiti and Brazil respectively, Scotland and Morocco will face off in this intriguing Group C encounter. The Scots made their World Cup return following 28 years away by bagging a sensational win over Denmark in the final day of UEFA qualifying. Things were far more straightforward for Morocco, as the 2022 semi-finalists won all eight of their African preliminaries to secure a straight World Cup berth.
[...]
Scotland's most recent World Cup match prior to 2026 came against the Atlas Lions in the pair's sole tournament meeting. They crossed swords in Saint-Etienne at France 1998, with both knowing a win could take them to the last 16. A goal from Abdeljalil Hadda either side of a Salaheddine Bassir brace ensured Morocco banked the points, though Norway's upset of Brazil in Marseille ensured neither side progressed.
[...]

Scotland return to the World Cup under coach Steve Clarke with a well-established tactical identity: structural discipline, full-back and wing-back-driven width, and a consistent emphasis on team shape over individual possession. The March 2026 Scotland squad confirms that the core still runs through Andrew Robertson, Scott McTominay, John McGinn, Billy Gilmour and the center-back unit.
